bibliography: Research synthesis prepared for Hemanta Gogoi with AI assistance. 28 October 2026. 32 pp. Historical research dossier; not a critical edition or genealogical certification.
description: A source-critical study comparing Chinese historical texts (Jiu Tang shu, Xin Tang shu, Man shu and Yuan shi), Tai and Shan migration traditions, historical geography and existing Ahom research materials. It distinguishes documented regional contact and continuity from plausible cultural transmission and the unproven claim of direct descent from Nanzhao rulers.
